content: Hello, this is Lisa from Amazon Customer Support. Is this Daniel Peterson?
Yes, this is Daniel. Did something happen with my account?
Thank you for confirming. I'm reaching out because we noticed a hold on your recent order due to a regulatory fee requirement. Don't worry, I'm here to assist you through the process.
A regulatory fee? I haven't heard of that before. Is my order canceled?

Your order is not canceled, but it's currently paused. This is a recent Amazon policy for international shipments. I assure you, we'll resolve this together, and your order will be released as soon as the fee is cleared.
I'm just worried because I can't afford to lose money right now. Is there any way to avoid the fee?

I completely understand your concern, especially in these times. Unfortunately, the fee is required by customs regulations, not Amazon. However, once processed, the amount is refunded to your account within 24 hours. May I confirm the email and phone number linked to your Amazon profile to proceed?
My email is daniel.peterson84@gmail.com and my number is 555-210-4567. Can you show me where Amazon mentions this policy?

Thank you, Daniel. Our updated policies are in the help section under 'International Orders & Fees.' I know it can be confusing. I'll personally make sure you get clear instructions and support every step. May I also verify your shipping address for security?
Sure, it's 1924 Elmwood Ave, Apt 3B, Seattle, WA 98122.

Perfect, thank you for confirming. Now, to avoid additional delays, I'll walk you through the payment process. Please remember, this is a temporary deposit and will be returned. For security, Amazon processes these fees via Amazon Gift Cards. Do you have access to a local store or can you purchase online?
I can get to a Walgreens nearby, but I thought Amazon would just charge my card.

That's a great question. For regulatory reasons, gift cards are used for one-time customs transactions, keeping your card information private and secure. This is standard for international orders. If you have your Amazon app, I can guide you on purchasing the cards.
I have the app. How much do I need to get?

Thank you, Daniel. The customs fee amounts to $250 for your order. To ensure a smooth process, please purchase Amazon Gift Cards totaling that amount and let me know when you have them. We have a limited timeframe before your order is auto-canceled.
That's a lot for me right now. Are you sure this is refundable?
Absolutely, the full amount is refunded to your Amazon account, usually within one business day. If you'd like, I can email you the confirmation once processed. You're in safe hands.
Okay, I'll try to go to Walgreens in a bit. What should I do after I buy the cards?

Once you have the gift cards, please carefully scratch off the silver strip and provide the codes here. I'll enter them into Amazon's customs portal and immediately send you a confirmation of the refund process.
Alright, I'll go get them now. Just to be sure, you won't need my credit card or bank info, right?

That's correct, Daniel. For your privacy, we never request banking details for customs fees. Just the gift card codes are required. If you have any issues at the store, please let me know and I'll help.
I'll message back when I have the cards. How much time do I have?
Since your order is on a temporary hold, we have about 30 minutes to submit the payment before the system flags the transaction. I'll be here to assist as soon as you're ready.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Thanks for helping.
Of course, Daniel. I appreciate your cooperation, and I'll make sure this gets resolved quickly for you. Please stay safe on your way to the store.
I'll update you soon.
Thank you! I'll be here when you return. If you have any questions or concerns, just let me know.
